# Tuteliq CLI

> Command-line interface for Tuteliq — detect bullying, grooming, and unsafe content from your terminal.

## What is this?
A CLI tool for the Tuteliq child safety API. Scan text, conversations, audio, and images for harmful content directly from the terminal.

## Install
npm install -g @tuteliq/cli
# or
brew tap Tuteliq/tap && brew install tuteliq

## Quick Start
export TUTELIQ_API_KEY=tq_your_key
tuteliq detect unsafe --text "message to check" --age-group 13-15
tuteliq detect grooming --file conversation.json --age-group 10-12
tuteliq detect bullying --text "you're so ugly" --age-group 10-12
tuteliq usage

## Commands
- tuteliq detect unsafe — Scan text for harmful content (KOSA categories)
- tuteliq detect bullying — Detect bullying patterns
- tuteliq detect grooming — Analyze conversations for grooming
- tuteliq analyze voice — Analyze audio files
- tuteliq analyze image — Analyze images
- tuteliq verify age — Age verification via document, biometric, or combined (Beta, Pro tier+, 5 credits, POST /v1/verification/age)
- tuteliq verify identity — Identity verification with document and selfie (Beta, Business tier+, 10 credits, POST /v1/verification/identity)
- tuteliq usage — Check credit balance
